applied.name: KWReplayFile_OpenWrite
applied.evidence: Thin _wfopen(filename, L"wb+") wrapper.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_OpenRead
applied.evidence: Thin _wfopen(filename, L"rb") wrapper.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_HasErrorOrEOF
applied.evidence: Returns true when ferror or feof is nonzero.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_IsEOF
applied.evidence: Thin feof(stream) predicate.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_Seek
applied.evidence: Returns fseek(stream, offset, origin) == 0.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_Tell
applied.evidence: Stores ftell(stream) and reports whether the result is nonnegative.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteU8
applied.evidence: Writes exactly one one-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteU16
applied.evidence: Writes exactly one two-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteU32
applied.evidence: Writes exactly one four-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteUTF16Z
applied.evidence: Writes UTF-16 code units through the terminating zero code unit.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteAsciiBytes
applied.evidence: Writes strlen(text) bytes without an extra terminator.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_WriteBytes
applied.evidence: Writes an exact byte count with fwrite.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ReadU8
applied.evidence: Reads exactly one one-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ReadU16
applied.evidence: Reads exactly one two-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ReadU32
applied.evidence: Reads exactly one four-byte value.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ReadUTF16ZBounded
applied.evidence: Reads UTF-16 code units until zero or the supplied capacity.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ExpectMagic
applied.evidence: Reads strlen(magic) bytes (maximum 20) and compares them exactly.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_ReadBytes
applied.evidence: Reads an exact byte count with fread.

applied.name: KWReplayReaderContext_Create
applied.evidence: Allocates and zeroes exactly 0xBB4 bytes, copies a 0x2C-byte source descriptor, and duplicates all owned source strings.

applied.name: KWReplayReaderContext_Destroy
applied.evidence: Closes file/transport state, frees owned strings/footer data, and frees the 0xBB4-byte reader context.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_CreateAndStart
applied.evidence: Creates the reader, installs three callbacks, and selects network, file, or archive-download startup from source mode 0, 1, or 2.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_Update
applied.evidence: Updates archive-download completion, network input, or timed file records according to the reader source mode.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_StartNetworkSource
applied.evidence: Initializes the network record decoder and opens the configured source.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_StartArchiveDownload
applied.evidence: Builds archiveN.KWReplay when needed and starts the asynchronous archive download job.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_ReleaseCurrentBodyRecord
applied.evidence: Releases network-decoder ownership when applicable and clears the current-record-valid flag.

applied.name: KWReplayJob_Update
applied.evidence: Dispatches the common replay job to reader or writer update by job kind.

applied.name: KWReplayJob_GetState
applied.evidence: Returns the common replay job state at offset 0x30.
